jobs.jobDescription:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re hiring a Developer Advocate. In this role, you’ll play a core part in improving our developer experience, particularly our documentation and example projects. You’ll dive deep into where users are getting stuck and ship what they need to succeed.

You’ll also help drive acquisition of our technical, self-serve customers by creating and presenting engaging content online and in-person, especially at developer meetups and conferences across the globe.

This role is perfect for someone who can create compelling technical content and is energized by connecting with developers face-to-face.

Requirements

  • You love attending, organizing, and speaking at developer events.

  • You're able to tailor messaging for different audiences and build strong networks with developers, startup accelerators, and VCs alike.

  • A strong full-stack engineering skillset with extensive experience working with AI tools.

  • The ability to come up with great ideas for tutorials, build working demos, and create high-quality blog posts, videos and talks.

  • A passion for writing engaging technical content.

  • A product-minded approach to content: you understand metrics, speak to users, decide what to build/write based on needs, and double down on what works.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.jobDescription:
Hello, I’m Steve, Director of Sales at Customer.io! We're expanding our sales team in the United States and seeking motivated and successful Account Executives at the Mid-Market level to join us! This role offers a unique opportunity to take your sales career to the next level, with potential for upward mobility.

As an Account Executive, you’ll represent Customer.io to prospective customers and drive growth within key market segments. This is a full-cycle sales role (prospect, demo, close), where you'll be fielding both inbound and outbound demand.

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

Responsibilities:

  • Pipeline Development and Management: Build and manage a pipeline through self-sourced leads and SDR-supported leads to drive new customer acquisition.
  • Full-Cycle Sales Execution: Lead the entire sales process from prospecting and discovery through demo and closing, focusing on new business acquisition within targeted accounts.
  • Customer Needs Analysis and Solution Alignment: Conduct discovery calls to understand customer business challenges and goals. Position Customer.io's solutions to meet these needs effectively.
  • Collaboration and Cross-Functional Feedback: Work closely with the SDR team for lead quality feedback and collaborate with Customer Success and Technical Support for a smooth hand-off post-sale.
  • Performance Tracking and Reporting: Own and report on individual sales metrics, including pipeline status and progress towards targets, to support informed decision-making.

Qualifications:

  • Experience: 2+ years of experience in full-cycle B2B SaaS or MarTech sales, handling mid-market accounts
  • Location: We are currently hiring for positions based in the United States. Candidates must be located in one of these regions to be considered for the role.
  • B2B SaaS or MarTech Experience: Proven success in new customer acquisition and closing deals within the B2B SaaS space, preferably MarTech
  • Sales Methodology: Familiarity with MEDDPICC or a similar framework that supports consultative selling and discovery to close.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and engaging presence to build rapport with new prospects.
  • Problem Solving: Strong ability to identify customer business needs and position relevant solutions effectively to drive acquisition
  • Deal Focus: Primarily handles mid-market accounts with shorter sales cycles and lower ACV deals
  • Support: Works closely with our SDR team for lead generation, with a balance between inbound and self-sourced opportunities
  • Responsibilities:
    • Engage in high-volume prospecting, cold and warm outreach
    • Manage the full sales cycle for deals typically under $50,000 ACV
    • Drive growth within mid-sized clients, nurturing relationships and uncovering business needs

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. We are offering a compensation package of $95,000 base + $95,000 variable for a total $190,000 OTE USD (or equivalent in local currency), subject to market rate adjustment. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  1. 30-minute video call with Recruiter
  2. 45-minute video call with Manager
  3. 30-minute video call with Bar Raiser
  4. 60-minute Case Study and Discovery Call w/ the Hiring Team

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io.

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We are passionate about our core values of Empathy, Transparency, Responsibility, and Awkwardness and are looking for new coworkers to share and build that passion!

jobs.jobDescription:
Nash is the autonomic logistics platform. Self-optimizing, self-healing AI Agents unify decisioning and execution across fleets, carriers, and fulfillment networks. Set the objective, and the system runs until you hit it. We’re 1,000+ customers across 20+ countries, backed by a16z and Y Combinator.

About this role

Nash is hiring its first global field and event marketing lead. You will own how Nash shows up in person: the event strategy for the company, and the field execution behind it in every region. You will build the event calendar with our regional GTM leads, and lead a team of regional field managers across APAC, EMEA and North America. You report to the VP of Growth and work directly with Sales leaders in each region.

What you own

  • The event calendar. You decide which shows and sponsorships earn a place, and how big Nash goes at each one.

  • The account list for each event, shared with Sales, so events and outreach point the same way.

  • What each event returned, and what that says about where Nash shows up next.

  • The field budget across regions, invested against pipeline and deal acceleration.

  • Every in-person moment Nash creates: booths, dinners, hosted events, gifting, merch and swag.

  • ABM events for our top accounts, built with the account teams. Executive dinners, onsites, and gifts made for one account at a time.

  • The relationships with show organizers, partners and vendors that earn speaking slots, better booth placement, and co-hosted events.

  • Vendors and production partners in every region. You choose them, set the terms, and hold them to the standard, across booth build, print, swag, freight and storage.

  • The content each event produces. You shoot your own, direct photographers and videographers, and get attendees and the team posting.

  • Internal events, including all-hands and company offsites, held to the same standard as the ones customers see.

  • The regional team. You hire the field managers, set the standard, and keep running the events that matter most yourself.

What you bring

  • 7+ years in B2B field or event marketing, across more than one region.

  • Shows you owned outright. You picked them, ran them, and answered for what came back.

  • You have run an event people wanted to come to and talked about afterward. One you were proud of, and that became a flagship part of the company.

  • A team you built and led across time zones, employees or contractors, including the hiring.

  • Super self-starter. You find the person who can unblock you, and you can put something good together on budget and with days' notice, then build the system that makes the next one easier to run.

  • Taste and polish. You know the difference between a booth people stop at and one they walk past, and the details guests notice are right, from the invite through the run of show.

  • Pipeline and the big picture. You can walk through the pipeline your events produced and how it moved, and you plan a year of events as one program rather than a series of one-offs.

  • AI already in your workflow, and something you built or improved that you can show us.

  • Command of budget and logistics at scale, and steadiness in the week of a show.

  • Willingness to travel 30 to 40% of the year.

How to Apply

Send us your resume, links or photos of events you have run, and a short note on the one you are proudest of and why. If you would rather skip the cover letter and send a Loom walking us through that event, the invite that filled the room, or the run of show behind it, that is very much encouraged.

Want to grab our attention and bypass the Recruiting platform? Record a video introducing yourself at testimonials.nash.ai with code JOIN-NASH. Your application pings us in Slack the moment it lands. If you are show ready at 8am on the first morning of a conference, this is nothing.

More about Nash

Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics.

Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.

Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.

We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.

Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco.

What You’ll Love About Us

✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career!
✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates
✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
✅ Flexible paid time off
✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

jobs.jobDescription:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

About the role

Sr. Director | Reports to the CMO | Leads a team of 4 | Global scope across the Americas, EMEA, and APJ | Location: US

You will lead the team that sets marketing's pipeline targets with Sales, measures what drives revenue, runs campaign operations, and builds the AI agents our marketers use every day. You will bring a point of view to the marketing leadership team on where we invest.

Why this role

  • Own the pipeline number with Sales. You will set marketing's pipeline targets by region, segment, and channel, and measure progress against them.
  • Build an AI-run marketing team on Dataiku. You will design and govern the agents our marketers rely on, and your work becomes a story we tell customers.
  • Shape where the money goes. Your analysis guides marketing investment decisions and reaches the CMO and the board.
  • High leverage, global reach. A team of four covering three regions, with a mandate to grow capacity through automation and AI rather than headcount.

What you will do

Set and measure the number

  • Build the funnel model that works back from bookings and ARR targets to pipeline, engagement, and coverage targets, agreed with Sales.
  • Launch a new account-based attribution model and make it the one Sales uses in pipeline reviews.
  • Own the marketing performance scorecard: one source of truth, shared with Sales, from brand awareness through account engagement to pipeline.
  • Measure the return on every program and event, so we fund what works and cut what doesn't.

Run the marketing engine

  • Lead campaign operations in HubSpot and Salesforce, with clear intake, quality, and turnaround standards for global and regional teams.
  • Own the marketing technology stack, roadmap, and budget, and simplify it.
  • Build account scoring, segmentation, and routing that match how Sales covers accounts.
  • Set the lifecycle, campaign naming, and data standards that make reporting trustworthy.

Build the AI layer

  • Build and govern Marketing's AI agents and GenAI workflows on Dataiku, from first idea through evaluation, review, and monitoring.
  • Get every marketer using these tools in their weekly work, and report the productivity gains.
  • Use automation and agents to grow the team's output without growing its size.

Guide investment

  • Provide the spend and performance data behind marketing's planning and budget decisions.
  • Run experiments and recommend where to move budget each quarter, by channel, region, and program.
  • Make performance data self-service, so marketers can answer their own questions.
  • Own data quality, privacy and consent compliance (including GDPR), and responsible AI use across marketing.

What you bring

Our Mission

Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve.

About Brain Co.

Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model.

Why Now

Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services.

Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact.

You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now.

About the Role

Build Brain Co.'s insurance business, from the first buyer conversation to a signed engagement. You'll originate opportunities and lead consultative sales through close, working with the GM of Insurance, product, engineering and deployment teams.

Our priority markets are property & casualty & life & annuities and the workflows span complex underwriting, claims, distribution and core operational processes where agentic orchestration of people and data can dramatically improve speed, quality and business outcomes.

Why Brain Co.

You'll help build the insurance business alongside the people developing and deploying the products. Your judgment will help determine which opportunities we pursue, how we win them and which recurring customer needs should shape the product.

Brain Co. builds AI systems that help large, regulated institutions carry out complex work. Our mission is to rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve.

What you'll own

  • Create demand. Help shape our pitch and narrative, open doors and build a pipeline through targeted outreach, executive and industry relationships, partners, conferences and events. Choose the right accounts, earn substantive meetings and turn follow-up into sales-qualified opportunities.

  • Discover and qualify. Convert marketing-generated and self-sourced leads into sales-qualified opportunities. Test the problem, economics, buyer, funding path and timing; know when to pursue, nurture or decline. Bring technical partners in early on data, security and implementation constraints.

  • Build the value case. Establish the customer's baseline and agree what improvement matters. Build clear briefs and proposals, partner with product and deployment on tailored demonstrations, and test the economic assumptions.

  • Lead the deal through close. Coordinate buyer and internal teams through scoping, pricing, security and legal review, procurement and negotiation. Validate commitments with product and deployment owners, then carry agreed scope, success measures and assumptions into a clear delivery handoff.

  • Inform what gets built. Distill recurring prospect needs, buying signals, objections and product gaps into recommendations for product strategy and roadmap priorities.

  • Build a repeatable sales motion. Keep account plans and forecasts accurate, learn from wins and losses, and create materials and practices that improve the next pursuit.

What you'll bring

  • 10+ years of relevant experience. You bring experience in enterprise sales, business development or management consulting, with direct accountability for originating opportunities and independently driving complex commercial engagements through close.

  • Complex multimillion-dollar closes. You've personally sold and closed custom technology deployments or tailored technology engagements, shaping bespoke solution scope, navigating implementation tradeoffs, building a quantified value case, negotiating contracts and aligning delivery commitments.

  • Insurance sales and domain depth. You've sold into insurance and can speak credibly about the industry's operating models, workflows and buying processes. You bring deep expertise in at least one of our priority markets: property & casualty, life & annuities, or specialty insurance.

  • Practical AI and technical fluency. You use AI in your own work, verify its outputs and can discuss data, integrations, evaluation and human oversight with buyers and technical partners.

  • Commercial judgment and execution. You create access, write clearly, put compelling materials together and keep several pursuits moving. You lead across teams without formal authority and do the detailed work yourself.

Bonus Points for

  • Experience selling AI products. You've won business for AI products or solutions and understand how customers evaluate, buy and deploy them.

  • Entrepreneurship. Experience building commercial motion and trusted relationships in a 0-to-1 startup environment.

Location and Travel

San Francisco, New York or remote on the East Coast preferred.

About the Company

Born from groundbreaking research at Columbia University and Yale University, CertiK is a leading Web3 security company focused on securing blockchain protocols, smart contracts, and decentralized applications through cutting-edge security research, formal verification, and AI-powered technology. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City, CertiK provides end-to-end security solutions including smart contract audits, penetration testing, on-chain monitoring, incident response, and compliance services for some of the largest projects in the digital asset ecosystem.

Today, CertiK supports thousands of enterprise clients and Web3 projects globally, with a distributed international team spanning North America, Asia, and Europe. The company is backed by leading investors including Coatue, Goldman Sachs, Insight Partners, and Sequoia Capital, and has been recognized by organizations such as the World Economic Forum and CB Insights for its contributions to blockchain security innovation.

About This Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented Web3 Business Development to join our team. You will be responsible for driving revenue growth by building relationships, expanding CertiK’s brand recognition, and closing revenue producing deals within specific channels in the Web3 space.

Responsibilities

  • Work closely with the Web3 Task Force Team to create stronger connections to the blockchain ecosystem.

  • Building a verifiable pipeline of qualified leads and consistently closing deals

  • Building brand recognition and fostering relationships within specific channels across the Web3 landscape.

  • Provide input on product development with insights from customer experiences and market trends.

  • Assist with sales and BD efforts including: Participating in direct sales, building strategic partner relationships, creating sales materials, and summarizing sales learnings for the team

  • Perform tasks cross-functionally among the various teams at CertiK.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in the Web3 BD space.

  • Collaborative and team-oriented approach to securing new revenues and improving internal efficiencies.

  • Actively tracking developments in the crypto ecosystem and opinionated on where it is going

Compensation

Additional Information

About the Role:

Influencer content is one of the highest-performing creative sources across our Meta and TikTok conversion programs, and we're investing further in it. We're hiring a Paid Media Influencer Analyst to sit at the intersection of our Influencer and Paid Media teams — sourcing, editing, launching, and measuring influencer-driven ads across multiple hims & hers product categories.

You'll work hand-in-hand with our influencer/creator team to help shape content that's built to convert, then take that content live through Meta Partnership Ads (allowlisting) and TikTok Spark Ads, and manage it like any other high-performing ad in the account. This role is ideal for someone who loves creator content but also wants to own the performance side — testing, optimizing, and scaling what works.

You Will:

  • Partner with the Influencer/Creator team to source and vet creators whose content and audience fit Hims & Hers paid media conversion goals across all product categories.

  • Write and guide all paid media influencer briefs and edits to ensure influencer content is optimized for conversion-focused paid ads, not just organic engagement.

  • Set up and launch influencer ads via Meta Partnership Ads (branded content allowlisting) and TikTok Spark Ads, ensuring proper permissions, tagging, and boosting are in place.

  • Manage and optimize live influencer ad campaigns, budget pacing, audience testing, and creative refresh to hit conversion and efficiency targets across categories.

  • Measure and report on influencer ad performance separately from and alongside brand/creative-led paid social, surfacing which influencers, formats, and hooks are driving results.

  • Build a repeatable system for tracking creator relationships, whitelisting status, content rights, and performance history.

  • Apply paid media amplification best practices to influencer content, including format, cropping, captions, and CTA placement by platform.

  • Feed performance learnings back to the Influencer team to inform which creators and content styles to prioritize for future partnerships.

  • Partner with Legal and Medical to ensure influencer content and disclosures meet healthcare marketing compliance requirements.

You Have:

  • Experience working directly with an influencer team, guiding content creation and editing toward conversion-focused paid outcomes (not just organic reach).

  • Hands-on experience with Meta Partnership Ads/branded content tools (allowlisting), including permissions setup and troubleshooting.

  • Hands-on experience running TikTok Spark Ads off creator organic posts.

  • Working knowledge of paid media amplification best practices for influencer and creator content across Meta and TikTok.

  • Experience in ecommerce or direct-to-consumer paid social, with the analytical skills to manage budget, measure performance, and optimize toward efficiency targets.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — you can work fluidly between creative/influencer partners and performance media teams.

  • Comfort with lightweight content editing/review to keep creator content on-brand and platform-ready ahead of launch.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in telehealth, healthcare, wellness, or another regulated or highly-compliant advertising category.

  • Familiarity with influencer/creator management platforms (e.g., Grin, Aspire, CreatorIQ).

  • Basic video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or similar) to guide or make quick creative tweaks.

  • Experience testing and scaling UGC or creator content beyond influencer-specific programs.

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

  • Offsite team retreats

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

About the Role:

The Communications team at Hims & Hers shapes how the world understands our role in advancing modern health, building strategies that raise awareness, foster brand love, trust, and loyalty, protect our reputation, and drive adoption of our products and services.

As technology becomes an increasingly central part of our story, from AI-native care to the platform innovations behind our consumer experience, we're looking for a communications leader to shape how we tell that story to the world. You'll lead high-priority work spanning technology and product storytelling, AI and innovation narrative, engineering culture and talent communications, and technical thought leadership, building a comms strategy that positions Hims & Hers as a technology company as much as a healthcare company. Reporting to the VP of Corporate Communications, you'll partner closely with Engineering, Product, Data Science, AI, Security, Investor Relations, Policy, and Marketing teams, plus our global Product Communications team, to translate complex technical work into stories that build trust, credibility, and excitement, both with the public and within the tech industry.

We're a team of intellectually curious, creative storytellers and problem solvers who love making the complex simple and the abstract resonate. This role calls for strong communications judgment, fluency in the technology and AI media landscape, and the ability to move easily between strategy and execution, translating deep technical work into narratives that resonate with consumers, trade press, and industry audiences alike. You thrive in the fast pace of a startup while stewarding a public company that serves people's health and well-being, and you know how to spot risk and opportunity in our technology narrative early, especially as AI and health intersect in ways the public is still learning to trust.

You Will:

  • Lead communications strategy for technology and AI in partnership with the broader comms team to build awareness, foster trust, and shape understanding of the engineering and innovation behind our products.

  • Drive communications for major technological product launches, shaping positioning, media strategy, and launch plans from day one.

  • Partner with leaders across Engineering, Product, Data Science, AI, and Security to build strategies grounded in the technical realities, roadmap, and priorities of what we're building.

  • Translate complex technical work, from AI models to platform infrastructure, into narratives that resonate with investors, consumers, media, and industry audiences without oversimplifying or overhyping.

  • Build and manage relationships with technology, business, and trade media, as well as industry analysts and influencers, to build trust, credibility, and thought leadership for Hims & Hers as a technology company.

  • Develop ongoing campaigns that extend beyond launch moments to grow our reputation as a technology innovator and support the business as it scales.

  • Serve as a strategic advisor and exec communications leader to the Chief Technology Officer and Chief Product Officer on high-profile moments, media opportunities, speaking engagements, and complex communications decisions, including those touching AI, data, and privacy.

  • Partner with the Internal Communications team on technology-focused moments, narratives and initiatives for Hims & Hers employees.

  • Partner with Corporate, Product, and Policy Communications on issues and reputation management, anticipating risk, especially around AI and health, and ensuring responses are clear, credible, and timely.

  • Use data and media insights to understand what's working and continually sharpen our impact and narrative over time.

You Have:

  • 10+ years of experience in communications, with direct experience in technology, product, and corporate communications, ideally with experience at a public company.

  • A track record leading communications for major product launches, technical announcements, or other high-profile moments.

  • Deep knowledge of the technology and AI media landscape, with strong relationships across relevant trade, business, and consumer technology press.

  • Experience partnering with engineering, product, data science, and technical stakeholders to translate complex work into clear communications.

  • Experience communicating in a space where technology, regulation, or reputational risk shapes how a company communicates, particularly around AI, data, or privacy.

  • Experience developing narratives that make complex products, technologies, or issues clear, relevant, and compelling to different audiences.

  • Ability to see the big-picture narrative while knowing when a specific announcement, audience, or moment needs a different message or approach to land.

  • Experience advising senior leaders and influencing cross-functional partners across Engineering, Product, Policy, Marketing, and other teams.

  • Excellent writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to move from strategy to execution when needed.

  • Ability to operate with speed and sound judgment as priorities shift quickly.

  • A data-driven approach to communications, with the ability to define success and use insights to improve strategy and execution.

  • Genuine curiosity about and fluency in emerging technology and AI, with the judgment to know what's substantive versus hype.

  • Willingness to travel as needed.

As part of the team, your skills will help organizations understand what skills they have, what they need next, and how to apply them in ways that drive real performance and progress.

Skillsoft is seeking an experienced Solutions Partner is a senior client-facing advisor and solution architect responsible for designing workforce transformation solutions that align business priorities, skills strategies, technology ecosystems, and measurable outcomes. This role combines consultative selling, technical solution architecture, value realization planning, and executive engagement to help customers solve complex talent, skills, leadership, compliance, and workforce development challenges.

In this role, the Solutions Partner will have the opportunity to own the end-to-end solution strategy and architecture throughout the customer lifecycle, ensuring alignment between customer requirements, technical feasibility, services design, implementation execution, expected business outcomes, and value realization.

Core Responsibilities

Strategic Discovery & Value Consulting

  • Lead structured discovery with broad buying committee across HR, Talent, Learning, IT, Data, Security, Enterprise Architecture, and executives to identify business priorities, workforce challenges, technical requirements, constraints, and success measures. Support account team in expanding advisory relationships
  • Translate customer needs into an outcome-based solution strategy aligned to business priorities and success measures.
  • Craft a compelling executive narrative that articulates the customer context, win themes, proposed solution, and expected outcomes.
  • Build a quantified business case that connects the proposed investment to value, ROI, and measurable impact.
  • Advise senior leaders on skills, talent, learning, workforce capability, and organizational transformation.

Technical Solution Architecture

  • Own the end-to-end solution strategy and architecture throughout the sales lifecycle, aligning customer requirements, technical feasibility, commercial viability, implementation considerations, and expected outcomes.
  • Design scalable solutions across Skillsoft offerings, professional services, partner technologies, customer environments, and operating models.
  • Lead technical discovery across systems, data, identity, security, integrations, implementation dependencies, assumptions, and risks.
  • Define success criteria and provide solution oversight or delivery advisory support as appropriate to protect solution integrity and value realization.

Skills Intelligence, Learning & Ecosystem Integration

  • Advise customers on skills-based transformation, workforce planning, talent mobility, capability development, and learning strategy.
  • Design practical ecosystem, integration, and data approaches that support skills intelligence, personalization, analytics, and measurable workforce outcomes.
  • Apply learning experience, adoption, and emerging technology principles to build solutions that drive behavior change and performance.

Transformation Roadmaps & Value Realization

  • Advise customers on value realization strategies and impact measurement approaches.
  • Design transformation roadmaps that align technology, skills strategy, learning experiences, adoption, governance, & services based on customer readiness and business value needs
  • Define implementation approaches, dependencies, risks, resource considerations, and success criteria.
  • Develop implementation assumptions, service designs, resource and effort considerations, risks, and success measures that support executable solutions.
  • Oversee services delivery for designed solutions, ensuring execution stays aligned to customer outcomes, delivery quality, and value realization goals.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Collaborate with Sales, Professional Services, Product, Customer Success, Marketing, and technical subject matter experts to shape, validate, position, and deliver solutions.
  • Translate customer needs into repeatable solution patterns, offers, and playbooks that improve quality, consistency, and deal velocity across markets.
  • Capture customer and market insights to inform product strategy, solution development, and go-to-market execution.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in solution consulting, solution architecture, workforce transformation, or enterprise technology consulting with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience engaging executive stakeholders and leading complex business and solution discussions.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise HR, talent, learning, workforce development, leadership, or people transformation initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect technology investments to measurable business outcomes and value realization.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Location: Central US with the ability to travel up to 30%

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience with HR technology, talent technology, learning technology, workforce analytics, skills intelligence, or enterprise SaaS platforms.
  • Understanding of enterprise architecture concepts, APIs, integrations, identity management, data exchange models, and platform interoperability.
  • Knowledge of and experience engaging HR, Talent, Learning, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Data, Security, or Digital Transformation stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with skills data models, talent intelligence platforms, AI-enabled workflows, and agent-to-agent integration concepts.
  • Experience developing executive business cases, transformation roadmaps, operating models, and value realization strategies.

Key Success Measures

  • Achievement of customer business outcomes
  • Executive stakeholder trust and engagement
  • Solution quality, scalability, and adoption
  • Solution win rates and expansion opportunities
  • Value realization and customer impact
  • Delivery quality against designed solution outcomes
  • Cross-functional leadership and collaboration
  • Contribution to market growth and innovation

Target base salary range for this job requisition is anticipated to be approximately $119,000 - $136,500 annualized with average on target earnings including commissions of approximately $170,000- $195,000 annually.

We also offer Enterprise benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, and paid time off

The company may modify salaries, salary ranges and/or Pay Plans from time to time as it deems necessary.

jobs.jobDescription:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

What you’ll do

As an Enterprise Account Executive covering strategic accounts, you’ll manage existing relationships and identify new opportunities to expand Stripe’s footprint within existing accounts. Specifically, we’re looking for someone who can execute on long-term sales strategies, engage with internal and external stakeholders, align on technical and business requirements with product teams, build value in competitive situations, lead commercial negotiations, and close deals.

Responsibilities

  • Work strategic Stripe customers to develop and execute long-term sales strategies to expand Stripe’s revenue
  • Expand business with high growth technology companies
  • Develop outbound strategies to create and nurture opportunities
  • Drive deal strategy and commercial negotiations for large, complex renewals
  • Develop relationships with executive stakeholders within your book of business
  • Be responsible for account mapping and coordinating effective meetings with the appropriate external stakeholders expanding the customer relationship
  • Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process and help shape the Stripe sales culture

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 15+ years of sales experience, preferably selling a highly technical product to strategic customers, with a track record of top performance
  • Ability to understand technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple products
  • Ability to develop and execute account plans spanning multiple business units across complex organizations
  • A knack for working well with a wide range of people, both internally and externally
  • Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders
  • Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreement
  • Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment
  • Strong interest in technology and a deep understanding of the space

jobs.jobDescription:
Quartzy is seeking a Vendor Relations Manager to build, manage, and grow strategic supplier relationships across our Life Sciences & Chemicals portfolios. You’ll drive growth and profitability by strengthening existing partnerships, identifying new opportunities, and bringing on strategic suppliers that expand and enhance our product portfolio.

Quartzy is a 100% distributed team so this role can be done anywhere in the US.

About You

You’re a relationship builder and problem solver who understands the Life Sciences industry and enjoys finding ways to create value for both suppliers and Quartzy. You’re commercially minded, data-driven, and comfortable navigating everything from supplier negotiations and business reviews to solving day-to-day challenges. You’re proactive, adaptable, and not afraid to roll up your sleeves, take ownership, and proactively find solutions as the business evolves.

Why Quartzy

At Quartzy, we believe science moves faster when labs spend less time on logistics and more time on discovery. Our platform streamlines how labs order, track, and manage supplies so researchers can focus on scientific breakthroughs that change the world.

Quartzy is the world’s #1 lab management platform, trusted by hundreds of thousands of scientists worldwide. By combining SaaS and eCommerce in a unique business model loved by customers, we help researchers spend less time on logistics and more time on discovery. From cancer research and climate change to winemaking and vegan cheese, our impact is broad and meaningful. You’ll have the flexibility of remote work, the security of a profitable business, and the purpose of contributing to discoveries that matter. At Quartzy, your work has an impact - on your life, your career, and on science worldwide.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and manage strong, profitable, and lasting supplier partnerships by negotiating pricing, terms, growth targets, incentives, and service expectations.

  • Drive supplier profitability and commercial performance by analyzing cost of goods, margin, sales, and growth trends and identifying opportunities for improvement.

  • Develop and execute supplier growth strategies, including pricing initiatives, promotional programs, incentives, and other opportunities to increase sales and customer engagement.

  • Lead supplier business reviews to evaluate performance, identify opportunities and gaps, establish priorities, and align on actionable plans for growth.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally across Quartzy to identify opportunities, address supplier and operational challenges, improve processes, streamline workflows, and support system and supplier integrations.

  • Own the resolution of escalated supplier issues, coordinating with internal teams and suppliers to drive timely resolution and maintain strong relationships.

  • Ensure data integrity across supplier catalogs and Quartzy systems, including Salesforce, Looker, and the Quartzy application.

  • Own supplier catalog health and optimization, developing and executing strategies to improve product content, data quality, assortment, and performance, including de-duplication and standardized catalog imports.

  • Develop and deliver cross-system performance reporting to provide leadership and key stakeholders with actionable insights into supplier performance, profitability, growth, and opportunities.

  • Identify opportunities to strengthen the supplier portfolio, using customer demand, performance data, market trends, and business priorities to inform supplier strategy.

  • Strategically manage and prioritize a portfolio of suppliers based on business performance, customer demand, strategic importance, and growth potential.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Science, or a related field.

  • 3–5+ years of relevant professional experience in Vendor Management, Sales, Business Development, Strategic Partnerships, Project Management, or a comparable role.

  • Experience in the Life Sciences industry, specifically in Life Science Sales, Scientific Distribution, Vendor/Supplier Management, or a closely related role.

  • Strong commercial and business acumen, with an understanding of pricing, margin/GP, ROI, profitability, and business performance.

  • Proven experience building and managing strong business relationships, including negotiating pricing, terms, incentives, and growth opportunities.

  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with the ability to evaluate performance, identify trends and opportunities, and translate data into actionable recommendations.

  • Proficiency with spreadsheets, CRM systems, and BI/reporting tools, with the ability to manage data and develop meaningful performance reporting.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with suppliers, internal stakeholders, and leadership.

  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, troubleshoot issues, and make sound business decisions.

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain data accuracy, and follow through on commitments.

  • Proactive, self-motivated, and willing to roll up your sleeves, with a demonstrated ability to take ownership and get things done in a fast-moving environment.

  • Collaborative and adaptable, with the ability to work independently, partner effectively across teams, and adjust to changing priorities.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful Work - Directly enable scientific discovery across biotech, pharma, and academia.

  • Remote-First Flexibility - Work from almost anywhere with autonomy and accountability.

  • Profitable & Growing - A stable, scaling business with clear long-term opportunity.

  • Support & Benefits - Competitive benefits and flexible time off to recharge.

  • Transparency & Trust - Weekly all company stand ups, monthly town halls, and anytime access to co-founders.

  • Team & Culture - Smart, mission-driven colleagues who value collaboration, accountability, and high performance.

Compensation

Does this sound like you? We'd love to hear from you.

Quartzy takes a market-based approach to pay, and pay may vary depending on your location. The pay scale salary/On-Target Earnings (OTE) range for this position represents the low, middle, and high end of the salary or OTE (sales roles) range for this position based on all US locations. To determine starting pay we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location and an evaluation of a candidate’s skills, experience, market demands, and internal parity. Salary/OTE is just one component of our total rewards package. The pay scale or OTE ranges may be modified in the future.

Salary range: USD $100,000 - USD $125,000 + Performance Based Bonus

All regular full-time employees are also eligible for excellent Medical, Dental and Vision coverage with generous premium contributions for both employees and their families, the option of a Health Savings Account with Employer Match, Company paid disability and life insurance with opportunity to add additional coverage for you and your family.

Additional Information

Quartzy provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. As part of this policy and legal compliance, Quartzy will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant or an employee unless undue hardship would result. Quartzy will also accommodate a religious belief or practice (including religious dress and grooming practices, such as religious clothing or hairstyles) if the accommodation is reasonable and will not impose an undue hardship.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Quartzy, Inc. will comply with any and all applicable local, city, county, state and federal laws, regulations and orders now in effect or which may hereafter be enacted.

jobs.jobDescription:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 50,000 students from more than 1,000 universities. Our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. After nearly a decade of training technical talent, we launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic to prepare people for careers in AI.

We're expanding into new markets and growing our team as AI changes the workforce. People joining CodePath now will help shape this next stage of our work.

We believe technical skills create opportunities. Our goal is to train millions of learners and create lasting economic impact. If you want to build something new, take ownership, and see the results of your work, this is a place to do it.

About the Role

Location: Remote (US), with travel about once a month
Role Type: Full-Time
Reporting to: Head of Higher Ed
Compensation: $110,000 to $150,000 per year

More than 50 colleges and universities offer CodePath courses for credit, taught by their own faculty or by CodePath. For a student, a seat in one of those courses means industry-vetted learning and career support built into the degree they're already earning. The courses only change outcomes if students know they exist and sign up.

That's your job. Students find us through a professor who mentions the course before registration opens, an advisor who forwards a note, a club event, or a friend who took the course last term. Most of that reach happens through people on campus, so your work is making it easy for faculty, advisors, career services, club leaders, alumni, and Tech Fellows to carry the message for us. You'll build all of it: the toolkits and campaigns they share, the campus presence, and the student community that recruits the next cohort. You'll be measured on how many students enroll and stay through add/drop, because each filled seat is one more student getting the training we exist to provide.

You'll be a dedicated partner to our Higher Education partnerships team, who own the relationships with faculty and campus leadership, and you'll own the student side of every partner campus. Some weeks that means building a one-pager a department chair can forward on Monday, tuning an email sequence on a Wednesday, and representing CodePath at a hackathon on Friday. You'll be building this function from the ground up and you need to decide in advance how we show up and what we expect back.

What you'll own

Partner activation and campaign development

  • Build and run a term playbook for each for-credit partner, from awareness through add/drop
  • Equip faculty, advisors, career services, and club leaders to market CodePath courses with toolkits, talking points, and assets they can forward
  • Turn national for-credit applicants into enrolled students: find where they drop off and test what moves conversion
  • Run virtual info sessions and campus landing pages that end with a clear path to register
  • Own email and SMS to opted-in students: build the list, run the campaigns, and work with our lifecycle contractor so campus and direct touches land as one sequence

Student community building

  • Design how alumni, Tech Fellows, and instructors show up on campus and engage students, and build the online side of that community (Discord and similar)
  • Own relationships with student clubs, CS and AI organizations, hackathon organizers, and campus chapters of national organizations like ColorStack, NSBE, and SHPE
  • Plan the event calendar a term ahead, with a clear standard for which events we do and what each should return

Measurement

  • Tie every sign-up to a channel and a partner, test timing, message, and channel, and move time and budget to what works
  • Use AI to run the playbook at 50+ campuses without adding headcount: toolkits per campus, calendars and send dates, results in one view

What success looks like in your first year

  • Every partner runs a term playbook, and fill rate and melt improve at for-credit partners
  • National for-credit conversion is measurably higher
  • Every new partner launches with a full first section
  • A student advocate network is live at our largest partners
  • The opted-in student list grows, and every sign-up traces to a channel

This role may be right for you if

  • You've owned an enrollment, sign-up, or acquisition number and moved it. You set up the tracking and can show which efforts drove the result
  • You've gotten partners to market on your behalf: individuals who carried your message because you made it easy for them, and you can show what it produced
  • You've built a campus, ambassador, or community program from the ground up and can show what it produced
  • You’ve built campaigns from concept to launch, including copy and creative, and run email or SMS to a list you built, changing them based on the numbers
  • You've decided where to spend time and money (events, channels, sponsorships) based on expected return, and cut what didn't deliver
  • You've run a program across many sites at once (campuses, chapters, regions) on a fixed calendar, and kept it on schedule without a team under you
  • You’ve built AI into how you work to automate the repetitive parts, and you can show what it changed
  • You want your growth work to widen who gets into tech careers

Bonus

  • Experience in enrollment or admissions marketing in higher education
  • You’ve built or scaled a technical community (a student developer org, hackathon community, Discord, or dev rel program) and can show how it grew
  • Hands-on HubSpot experience
  • You're comfortable speaking at events and on panels on behalf of CodePath

Compensation

CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position's level, no matter where you live. For this role, we're hiring for a Senior Manager level position at an annual salary of $110,000 to $150,000. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process.

Full-Time Employee Benefits

This is a remote position—work from anywhere in the US! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program
  • Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection
  • Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)
  • Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support
  • ​​Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt
  • Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings

Pay range

$110,000—$150,000 USD

jobs.jobDescription:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

We seek an energetic, optimistic, curious, and empathetic coach and leader to manage a growing team of Enterprise Solution Engineers across the US West, driving the next wave of customer outcomes.

As Director, Sales Engineering in the US West, you will:

  • Lead a team of trusted advisors who are responsible for demonstrating the value of Dataiku’s AI and Agent Management platforms.
  • Partner with the sales organisation to earn new and retain existing Dataiku clients by championing and delivering AI-enabled business strategies.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across product, marketing, sales, customer success, and others to align on AI native go-to-market motions.
  • Mentor your team; hire and retain top talent with a strong focus on balancing tech and sales expertise.

You'll be successful in this role if you can:

  • Coach sales engineers on Dataiku’s evolving product value, competitive differentiation, and the application of the Challenger Sales methodology.
  • Serve as a player/coach to engage on high-profile customer opportunities, providing a strategic lens and elevating delivery.
  • Serve as a technical point of contact for sales leadership; communicate technical risks and opportunities faced in sales engagements
  • Mentor team members; host regular check-ins, provide career guidance, and hire and scale the team.
  • Build strong working relationships with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on delivering customer outcomes.
  • Communicate directly with sales leadership to strategise around adoption and expansion.
  • Host enablement sessions focusing on the latest in technology trends.
  • Partner with the Sales Engineering leadership to refine key performance indicators for your team.

You could be a good fit if you have:

  • At least five years of experience in sales engineering.
  • At least two years of people management experience, including a passion for building and hiring teams.
  • Experience in complex/large-scale enterprise AI and analytics deployments.
  • Deep understanding of the AI landscape, including foundation models, LLMOps, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and autonomous AI agents.
  • Experience building and enabling high-performing technical teams in a rapidly evolving AI market.
  • Demonstrated intellectual curiosity regarding the intersection of business, traditional machine learning, and Agentic AI technologies.

Other preferred qualifications:

  • Proficiency in programming languages (Python, R, SQL, Java, etc.).
  • Experience with cloud services and their respective AI/ML services (AWS Bedrock, Azure Foundry, GCP Vertex AI, etc.).
  • Understanding of the modern AI lifecycle, including LLM fine-tuning, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, agentic orchestration, alongside the traditional machine learning lifecycle (feature engineering, model training, model deployment).
  • Knowledge of machine learning and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn.
  • Experience driving AI Native GTM transformations
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to demystify complex AI concepts for executive audiences.

Compensation and Benefits

The final compensation package for this role will be determined during the interview process and is based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, geographic location, internal equity, education, skill set, experience and training. Eligible roles may also be entitled to receive commission or other variable compensation through Dataiku's incentive compensation program.

Dataiku also offers comprehensive benefits, including stock options, medical, dental, and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, pre-tax commuter benefits, a 401k company match, paid vacations and sick leave, paid parental leave, employer paid disability coverage, and additional health and wellbeing perks and benefits. Dataiku reserves the right to amend or modify employee perks and benefits at any time.

US only national base pay ranges

$187,000—$234,000 USD

What are you waiting for!

At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our Dataiku LinkedIn page.

Our practices are rooted in the idea that everyone should be treated with dignity, decency and fairness. Dataiku also believes that a diverse identity is a source of strength and allows us to optimize across the many dimensions that are needed for our success. Therefore, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All employment practices are based on business needs, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. This applies to all policies and procedures related to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion and termination and all other conditions and terms of employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact us at: reasonable-accommodations@dataiku.com

Protect yourself from fraudulent recruitment activity

Dataiku will never ask you for payment of any type during the interview or hiring process. Other than our video-conference application, Zoom, we will also never ask you to make purchases or download third-party applications during the process. If you experience something out of the ordinary or suspect fraudulent activity, please review our page on identifying and reporting fraudulent activity here.

No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

Hims & Hers is seeking an experienced Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Marketing team. The successful candidate will be a strategic thinker, skilled storyteller, and expert influencer with the demonstrated ability to drive consensus across Product Management, Creative, Acquisition, and Retention teams. This individual will synthesize customer insights and data to drive go-to-market strategies and product adoption. In this role, this individual will build upon their understanding of consumers’ healthcare needs to optimize our existing offering and drive updates to better meet customer needs. Strong communication skills will be important, and this person will be able to confidently share strategies that educate and inspire internal and external partners at all levels.

This is a temporary position for 6 months.

You Will:

  • Champion the voice of the customer to prioritize products and experiences to best address consumers’ healthcare needs

  • Operate in a highly cross-functional role, partnering closely with Product/Engineering, Category Management, Integrated Marketing, Creative, Brand, Growth Marketing, Insights, and Product Development to scale the offering

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Design, and Analytics to shape digital customer experiences that drive conversion, engagement, and retention

  • Lead identification of the right segmentation, positioning, messaging, and adoption tactics for new and existing products in focus area(s)

  • Develop differentiated product/feature positioning and messaging informed by customer insights, market trends, and competitive analysis

  • Develop thoughtful go-to-market strategies and briefs anchored in customer insights and an understanding of competitive/macro landscape

  • Drive experimentation strategy in partnership with Product Management, Design, Acquisition, and Lifecycle teams to optimize efforts

  • Lead complex workstreams and/or product segments with minimal oversight

  • Own end-to-end work across multiple categories and product lines

You Have:

  • 7+ years of experience in marketing; 5+ of those years in product marketing specifically (or similar roles like GTM, consumer marketing, or integrated marketing strategy)

  • Strong storyteller with the ability to develop campaigns that get customers’ attention and build product brands people love

  • Ability to drive experimentation focused on conversion and engagement

  • Analytical thinker with experience in data-driven marketing

  • Experience using insights and strategic thinking to influence stakeholders and the product roadmap

  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional teams

  • Team player who is accountable, proactive, and solution-oriented

jobs.jobDescription:
At Skillsoft, we believe skills fuel growth. Our mission is to empower every organization and every learner to turn constant change into continuous growth. As part of the team, your skills will help organizations understand what skills they have, what they need next, and how to apply them in ways that drive real performance and progress.

Skillsoft is seeking an experienced Growth Account Executive to be responsible for creating measurable and defined business goals with timelines, (related to revenue and growth of whitespace) for our ground-breaking products by building positive relationships with customers through digital communication. 

Our Growth Account Executives (Enterprise Accounts) grow an existing account territory, applying a hunter mentality with a strategic, solution-selling approach. In this needs-based, relationship sales role, you will have the opportunity to sell to a diverse spectrum of industries. The ideal candidate will have a track record of over-quota achievement and will grow an ambitious pipeline of business. This will require the ability to navigate through complex organizations and sell to multiple decision-makers, including the “C Suite”.

Remote - Western Time Zone

Responsibilities:

  • Drive top-line revenue through growth of an existing enterprise account base
  • Sell Skillsoft Content and Platform solutions directly to corporate decision makers
  • Influence customers at the senior leadership level and win by building relationships across different lines of the account offering solutions to what they are trying to solve for
  • Partner with related sales, customer success managers, marketing, and support resources in the successful advancement of critical opportunities
  • Be responsible for preparing and delivering executive presentations with research, data, agendas and a tailored presentation coupled with impeccable follow-up
  • Create measurable and defined business goals with timelines, (related to revenue and growth of whitespace)
  • Provide management, feedback and recommendations on pipeline health, risk, opportunity, and progress

Skills & Qualification Required:

  • Minimum 5+ years of direct sales experience, selling SaaS, B2B, enterprise software to VP, SVP, and C-Level Executives with outstanding quota attainment history
  • Ability to travel 30-50% to customers in a regional territory
  • Proficient in Salesforce and MS Office Suite with a strong attention to detail and pipeline documentation
  • Ability to exceed sales targets, a keen understanding of the steps involved in a sales cycle and ability to leverage each stage to advance the sale
  • Skilled at demonstrating solutions and speaking the language of corporate buyers and respectfully challenge their thinking and able to negotiate effectively based on value and time to close
  • Ability to collaborate and leverage subject matter expertise in a matrixed sales environment
  • Be self-motivated, hungry and proficient in operating with a sense of urgency and demonstrate a positive, winning attitude

Desirable Requirements

Target base salary range for this job requisition is anticipated to be approximately $105,000 - $125,000 annualized with average on target earnings including commissions of approximately $210,000- $250,000 annually.

We also offer Enterprise benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, and paid time off

The company may modify salaries, salary ranges and/or Pay Plans from time to time as it deems necessary.

Skillsoft is trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 1000, and supports a global community of more than 105 million learners. Learn more at skillsoft.com.
